verdict.rationale: Homebrew is a local package manager. Its only API in the evidence is a public, read-only formulae JSON listing, with no user accounts or authenticated service from which agent credentials could be issued, so scoped API credential issuance is outside its category. The evidence on non-admin installs, HOMEBREW_NO_SUDO and as-console-user covers OS privilege handling, not API credentials, and cannot be credited here.
